001package services;
002
003import base.User;
004import models.Admin;
005import models.Manager;
006import models.Student;
007import models.Teacher;
008import enums.Role;
009/**
010 * Factory Design Pattern implementation for User creation.
011 * Centralizes object instantiation logic to maintain low coupling.
012 */
013public class UserFactory {
014
015    /**
016     * Static factory method to create concrete User instances.
017     * @param role target role to instantiate
018     * @param login user login
019     * @param password raw password (will be hashed internally)
020     * @param name user full name
021     * @return concrete instance of Student, Teacher, etc.
022     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the role is not supported
023     */
024    
025    public static User createUser(Role role, String login, String password, String name) {
026        switch (role) {
027            case STUDENT:
028                return new Student(login, password, name);
029            case TEACHER:
030                return new Teacher(login, password, name);
031            case ADMIN:
032                return new Admin(login, password, name);
033            case MANAGER:
034                return new Manager(login, password, name);
035            default:
036                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported role: " + role);
037        }
038    }
039}
